lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical striae of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal spot alignments, particularly visible on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient (superior highlight, inferior shadow) extending along the upper two-thirds of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance spots distributed across the first dorsal fin, with higher clustering observed towards the basal and posterior regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four remora-like organisms clustered near the ventral surface and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
